proposal.reason: Main change is in P2P transport registration flow: it now registers full cached ranges that span multiple physical segments, exports/imports per-segment handles, tracks segment counts, and updates deregistration/cleanup paths in transport/p2p. An additional network review is needed because proxy/UDS behavior changed independently (batch FD query API, per-connection imported-handle tracking queue, and proxy-side lifecycle teardown), which affects network proxy resource/protocol handling.
